"Still on whether you're staying."
"Another time. The village needs me here."

"I dreamed Easton was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
"Okay. That's — I need a minute. A long minute."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."

"Still on whether you're angry. ...sorry, I'm spiraling."
"I can't. Not today. Ask me when the work's done."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Easton Ahmed is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Easton Ahmed is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Easton kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Easton's gone." Aaliyah looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Easton." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Bridget blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Easton Ahmed, 41 days. The mantle passes to Bridget Zaitsev.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Bridget Zaitsev, 65 — a piano tuner. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Easton — and Easton is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Aaliyah, Antonio, Dumisani and 7 more speak for Bridget — "Easton trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Bridget before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+13 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
